hard_requirement: No tileset/pack is assumed complete. Semantic scene requirements remain separate from available permitted assets; missing assets remain explicit or use an approved placeholder rather than silent invention.

mai09_start.input: validated MAI-08 draft snapshot/receipt plus preserved MAI-01..08 evidence
mai09_start.preflight: fail closed on invalid receipt, blocking evidence, visibly-unresolved activation, stale owner references or denied/unknown/revoked permission
mai09_start.world: stable MIB-11/D18 references only; no topology/navigation inference from presentation
mai09_start.scene: A5 semantic placement/map-version proposals with expected versions and operation IDs; owner result required for mutation
mai09_start.visibility: visibility-policy references and hints only; owner resolves audience/hidden/occlusion/LOS
mai09_start.gameplay: explicit owner object/action bindings only; visual geometry/connectivity never becomes collision/cover/movement/interaction/trigger/portal truth automatically
mai09_start.creator: D29 proposal/review/publication handoff; MAI receipt is not publication evidence
mai09_start.reconciliation: partial owner acknowledgements and ambiguous outcomes remain explicit; operation-status lookup before retry

boundaries: MAI-01..08 completed_verified and have no further implementation authority
MAI-09 in_progress only on its governed implementation branch
no vendor/editor/provider schema is canonical Multiversal truth
no pack is assumed complete and semantic requirements remain separate from chosen art
MAI-08 drafts remain integration inputs only until owner acceptance
manual/placeholder/unresolved states remain explicit and visibly-unresolved cannot activate
MIB-11/D18, A5 Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions, Combat/Exploration and D29 retain owner truth
MAI-09 may emit deterministic owner requests/acknowledgement/reconciliation evidence only
migration 0022 remains unreserved absent demonstrated durable schema delta
no MAI-10 implementation from this authority
